itemTexts.description: A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
A magical wrapping capable of binding up to five scrolls.
Sturdy shafts that fly straight and true.
Small figures used to summon giant rats.
A stout stick covered in pitch.
Paper of superior quality needed for the etchings of magical words.
These things belonged to the blacksmiths son.
The babe you helped delivered from the now dead orcish mother.
What they lack in taste they more than make up for in nutrition.
A strong coil make of Hemp and Flax.
A highly polished plate of pure silver.
Heavy Iron spikes capable of being driven into the hardest of stone.
In combination with flame this becomes a poor mans fireball.
A fine wine distilled in the sunken city of Waterford
This fine document will allow you to gain entrance into Castle Antrax whenever you wish.

monsterDescriptions.text: A giant frog.  What else can you say?
Large, slow, stupid.  Put it all together and you have a four- footed eating machine with sharp teeth.
Not a true dragon.  Named after one because it is the only beast known that can rival a dragon's brute strength.
A mindless larva.  Nobody knows what this thing will turn into because it has never been found in a cocoon state.
Capable of launching a multitude of attacks, this critter is extremely deadly.
Skilled in the art of archery.
Humanoid in shape.  Made from a colony of semi-intelligent mosses.
Be careful not to fall victim to its bite.  It has been known to cause paralysis.
A poisonous bite may be the least of your worries if you meet up with one of these vermin.
Sporting a nasty bite, these critters are more dangerous than they look.
Incapable of rapid movement, these bizzar creatures spawn podlings.  The podlings act as mindless slaves.
A powerful cousin to the modern day mountain lion.
Though slow moving and mindless, they will do the bidding of the Mush Mound which spawned them.
Strongest of the evil dragons.  Few are those that have met with one, and LIVED!
Woe are the fools that find themselves in lonely company with one of this ilk.
One of the weaker races of dragon kind.  A sly mind and a taste for blood make green dragons a force to be feared.
Disgusting to behold, the smell of these creatures is a strong clue as to their diet.
Large and heavily armored with a bony back plate and horns.  Only a fool would back one of these things into a corner.
Large and brutish.  These simple- minded humanoids survive due to there sheer size.
A hardy warrior trained for combat.  A true asset to the king.
A true leader of men.  Trusted with the task of keeping the troops in line and loyal to the king.
A smaller dinosaur that must hunt in packs in order to bring down larger prey.
Standing 8 feet tall or more, these large brutes love to bully those weaker than themselves.  They are often employed as troops in mercenary armies.
A strong family structure allows these giant reptiles to survive in a hostile environment.
Young and weak when compared to a fully grown giant.  Still more than a match for any full grown human or orc.
Extremely strong for their size, these beasts make excellent warriors.
Neither very fast nor powerful. These nasty reptiles do have one advantage - a poisonous bite.
Hailing from some unknown plane, these beasts are often summoned by powerful enchanters to do their bidding.
Though not native to the nine planes of hell, they populate large regions of that foul area.
The creature's favorite form of attack is to lower its armored head and charge.  Don't stand in front of it when it does.
These minor devils live their lives as servants to those more powerful than themselves.
A powerful creature of the undead.  These creatures drain your life force.
Filthy claws can cause disease if they break the skin.
An old wretch with little to loose in life.
Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.
They sport a nasty chemical attack.  Oh, I guess it may be worth mentioning.  They may split into two slimes when killed.
Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.
A creature of the undead.  This foul creature's touch can cause disease.  They also regenerate wounds so it is best to kill them as fast as you can.
A storm of claws and fangs.  Your basic garden variety of giant spider.
A strange race indeed.  Not even the oldest of elven sages know of the oragins of this foul race.  Some speculate they are not of this world.
A humanoid raised from the dead to become one of the cursed undead.
A disgusting blind creature of the deep.  Four clawed feet, two tentacles and a trunk that resembles an elephants all combine to make this a creature to avoid.
A small, reptilian race.  They are extremely evil and travel in large groups for they are small in stature and are often eaten as food if found alone.
A giant boar with a bad attitude.
Completely mindless.  They are used as shock troops and as food by most other demons.
An apparition from beyond the grave.  Niether good nor evil by nature, it is still best to avoid such creatures.
An apparition from beyond the grave and extremely evil by nature.  It's good pactice to stay clear of these whispy creatures.
Long dead creatures of a larger race.  Many such creatures were once gnolls, bug bears, ogres or true giants.
A common orc who claims to have some skill with weapons.
Small and weak.  Goblins band together in large tribes for their own protection.
A strong goblin warrior that has risen above those of more ordinary skill.
Pressed into service to pay off depts, these troops are not much of a match for those skilled with weapons.
Somewhat skilled with weapons.  The preferred weapon is the bow.
Big as a thespian devil cat and twice as mean.  These men are solely paid to keep the troops in line.  They use force if necessary.
A would be leader of men.  Most die in battle at the hands of thier own men if they are not careful.
An experienced leader with the respect of his troops.  Few will question his orders.
Filthy claws and teeth make this creature a deadly menace.  Fear it's bite for it can paralize.
A blaze of claw and fang.  The speed of these nether world creatures is almost without compare.
Normally they feed on only the dead, but in times of hunger they will hunt their prey.  They are semi-intelligent and travel with other that feed on carrion.
Abused as youngsters, these ill- tempered men are but common thugs for hire.
Pickpocket, cutpurse, burglar.  By any name, a thief is a thief.
A small demon from the nether region.  In large numbers though they can be a difficult force to deal with.
Avoid the paralyzing bite of these large insects.
Half man.  Half fish.  All bad temper.
Only slightly less primitive than a caveman.  These humanoids bear a much closer resemblance to animals than to humans.
Only slightly less primitive than a caveman.  These humanoids bear a much closer resemblance to animals than to humans.
Quick and nimble, this hardy race is known for thier ability to find a mechanical way to achive almost any task.
A common vermin of immense size.
Skilled in the art of archery.
A paralyzing sting makes these insects as deadly as they look.
Over 2 feet of pure terror.
Above average in both skill and size.
Capable with the bow and prefers to pepper its enemies from afar.
A large filthy rat.  Its bite can cause disease.
With special attacks and the ability to summon other giant rats to aid it in battle, this mystic creature is one best left alone.
